scope: Real public JAR declaration inspection, not installation, startup, gameplay, performance, or Windows UI validation.

acquisition.mode: Official Modrinth API and API-returned CDN files read before additional retrieval became unavailable. No JAR was executed.

final_verification.mode: Offline replay of previously recorded official API responses and verified real JAR bytes through production ModrinthProvider, FabricJarInspector and ModrinthInspectionService; no network fallback.
final_verification.oracle_independent: Python standard-library API/archive inspection plus official Fabric Loader source; not the production detector used as its own expected-result oracle.
